title: Short Form Video Editor for US Video Production Agency (20+ hrs/week, Long Term)
description:
Thrivr Productions is a US based video production and paid media agency working with home service businesses and professional speakers. We are hiring a video editor to help us produce social media ads and short form content at volume.

What you will be doing:

You will take raw footage we film and turn it into finished short form videos. This means:



Filtering through raw footage and selecting the best takes

Applying a LUT to color the footage

Adding captions

Adding music

Cutting in b-roll



Here is an example of the type of post you will be creating: 

These are simple, fast edits. You are expected to produce 2 to 4 of these per hour once you are trained on our style. This is a speed and consistency role, not a cinematic editing role.

How pay works: Levels

This role has performance based pay levels. Every editor is placed at a level, and each level has a higher payout. You move up by consistently delivering quality work at speed.



Most editors start at Level 1 and level up as they prove themselves

If you are a more experienced editor, you will not be forced to start at the bottom. Submit your best work with your application and you will be placed at the level that matches your skill

As your level increases, so does your pay and the type of projects you get (ad creative, advanced editing, larger client projects)



This means the better and faster you get, the more you earn. We want editors who are motivated by that.

Requirements:



Proven experience editing short form content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)

Proficient in Premiere Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve

Able to work fast without sacrificing quality

Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video editing

Strong written English and responsive communication

Available 20+ hours per week with room to grow into full time



To Apply:



Start your application with the word MANGO so I know you read this entire post

Include a link to an example of your work that is most similar to the example video above, this is what we will use to place your starting level

Include your portfolio or 2 to 3 additional short form videos you have edited

Tell me which editing software you use

Tell me your weekly availability



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

title: Director of Talent Acquisition and People Operations
description:
Urgent Hiring — Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.



Ready to Empower a Growing Team and Shape Our Future?



At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.

We are seeking a Director of People Operations to join our team and build the systems that will drive our next phase of growth. If you are passionate about creating scalable people systems, empowering teams, and cultivating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact.



About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.



Our Mission:



We design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. We create beautifully designed, developmentally sound tools that replace noise and distraction with connection, curiosity, and real learning.



Our Vision:



We aim to build the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families.



Role Overview



As the Director of Talent Acquisition & People Operations, you will own how Hadley Designs sources, vets, and closes top global talent, and you will own the broader people system that talent steps into. You will partner with leadership to design the recruiting engine that consistently delivers strong top-of-funnel for every open role, and you will scale the people systems that hold a remote, contractor-centric organization together as it grows toward $100M and beyond.



This is a leadership-tier role with 1 direct report (the People Operations Specialist) and end-to-end ownership of the talent and people functions. Your weeks will be heavier on recruiting in the near term, live pipelines, structured interviews, test projects, employer brand, and steady on People Operations throughout (onboarding, performance frameworks, contractor renewal, leadership enablement).



Key Responsibilities



Talent Acquisition (the #1 outcome of this role):

• Recruiting Pipeline Management: Source candidates across LinkedIn, job boards, freelancer platforms, and referrals; filter applicants for red flags, competency match, and scorecard alignment.

• Test Project & Interview Operations: Run test projects, review submissions, conduct first-round group interviews, and manage candidate experience end-to-end.

• Sourcing Channel Optimization: Manage and optimize sourcing channels based on performance; build "always hiring" shortlists for recurring high-leverage roles.

• Employer Brand & Glassdoor Defense: Monitor and manage Glassdoor reviews, organize team review drives, ask for feedback, flag issues, protect brand rating.

• Hiring Metrics & Funnel Reporting: Deliver weekly hiring pipeline reports broken down by channel and role; track funnel performance against KPIs.



People Operations:

• People Systems Leadership: Design and implement systems for engaging, onboarding, and retaining talent, align

ed with the company's growth objectives.

• Organizational Design and Capacity Planning: Collaborate with leadership to ensure that the organizational structure and workforce planning meet the evolving needs of the business.

• Performance and Development Frameworks: Establish performance expectations, evaluation frameworks, and development pathways that drive accountability and growth across the organization.

• Talent Experience and Retention: Build a consistent and professional experience for talent that reinforces employee engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

• Workforce Insights and Reporting: Provide insights and data-driven recommendations to leadership to guide decision-making and improve workforce effectiveness.

title: SEO Expert & Website Designer
description:
Location: Remote · Type: Part-time now, with full-time opportunity · Reports to: Owner / Lead Strategist



Who We Are

Scale Local is the marketing department for local service businesses: roofers, contractors, law firms, dentists, and other operators who do great work but are hard to find online. We don't sell tactics. We build connected growth systems. SEO that wins local intent, Google Business Profiles that rank, websites that capture leads, and automations that make sure no lead slips through.



Our philosophy is "The Human Touch," meaning modern technology and AI paired with real human judgment. We use AI to do better work, not to replace the thinking.



The Role

This is an SEO-first seat. You own keyword research, competitive and gap analysis, on-page and technical SEO, local search, and the new frontier of getting our clients cited and ranked in AI search (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews).



You'll also implement your own changes on client WordPress sites: meta, content, internal links, schema, and page tweaks. So light hands-on web ability is required. This is not a web design role. Design is handled. We need you comfortable enough in WordPress/Elementor to ship the changes your strategy calls for.



It starts part-time, with a clear path to full-time as we grow the client base. The right person grows into a core technical seat on the team.



What You'll Do

Keyword research and strategy: map buyer intent for local services, build out targeting for service and location pages

Competitive and gap analysis: know exactly where clients sit vs. competitors and what closes the gap

On-page SEO: titles, metadata, headings, internal linking, content structure

Technical SEO: crawlability, indexation, site speed and Core Web Vitals, schema/structured data (JSON-LD), redirects, canonicals

Local SEO: service/location pages, Google Business Profile optimization, map-pack ranking, review velocity

AI search optimization (AEO): structure content and entities so clients get cited by AI engines, not just classic search

Reporting: track rankings, map-pack movement, and organic performance, and explain what's moving and why

Implement changes in WordPress/Elementor (no design work, just execution of SEO changes)

Tools

You should already work fluently in a real SEO research suite such as Semrush or Ahrefs (or equivalent). We can provide access if needed, but you need to know how to drive these tools, not learn them on the job. GA4, Google Search Console, and rank-tracking software round out the stack.



You're a Fit If You

Have a genuine command of the SEO landscape. You understand why things rank, not just checklists.

Know current technical SEO best practices cold

Understand how to rank in both classic and AI search, and how the two differ

Use AI to amplify your work, not do it for you. You can prompt and leverage tools like ChatGPT and Claude, but you bring the strategy, judgment, and quality control. We are not hiring someone who pastes everything into an AI and ships the output.

Can implement your own SEO changes in WordPress (Elementor a plus)

Write clear English at a B level minimum (client-facing reports and on-site copy)

Bonus Points

Experience in home services, legal, or medical local marketing

Basic PHP and comfort with WordPress code snippets and the REST API

GoHighLevel or CRM familiarity

Light copywriting chops

Why Scale Local

Real ownership of client outcomes. Your work generates calls and booked jobs, not just impressions.

A systems-driven team that thinks in connected engines, not one-off tasks

Part-time now with genuine room to grow into full-time

The ideal candidate can take a project brief, conduct reliable research, ask smart questions, and turn complex or technical information into content that is easy to understand. You should know how to adjust your writing based on the audience, channel, and purpose of each project. An educational article should not sound like an advertisement, and a video script should not sound like a brochure.



You should be comfortable writing across both short-form and long-form formats, including:



- Website pages and landing pages

- Educational and search-focused articles

- Sales and marketing
s

- Social media posts

- Video scripts

- Google Search and digital advertising copy

- Brochures, sell sheets, and sales materials

- Presentation and webinar copy

- Customer communications

- Headlines, calls to action, and campaign messaging



Strong editing and proofreading skills are essential. You must be able to review your own work carefully for grammar, clarity, accuracy, consistency, and adherence to project requirements. Attention to details such as character limits, word counts, formatting instructions, citations, and brand voice is important.



Experience writing search-engine-optimized content is preferred. You should understand how to incorporate keywords naturally, organize articles for readability, write effective titles and headings, and balance search performance with a strong reader experience.



This role may involve writing about workplace first aid, safety, healthcare-related products, training, and other topics where accuracy matters. You do not need to be a medical expert, but you must be comfortable conducting research, using reputable sources, citing information when appropriate, and avoiding unsupported claims.



We are looking for someone who writes in a natural, human voice. Our preferred style is clear, direct, confident, and conversational. We want content that sounds like it was written by a knowledgeable person who genuinely wants to help the reader, not a legal document, generic marketing copy, or an aggressive salesperson.



This is not an entry-level position. We are looking for a senior writer who can work independently, manage multiple assignments, make strong editorial decisions, and consistently produce polished work. You should be open to feedback and comfortable revising content based on input from marketing, sales, operations, and company leadership.



Strong English communication, organization, reliability, responsiveness, and the ability to meet deadlines are required.



This is a full-time position for someone looking for consistent, long-term work with one company. We are not looking for an agency, content mill, or part-time freelancer. We are looking for an individual writer who can become a trusted member of our marketing team.



The use of artificial intelligence tools is permitted when appropriate, but all submitted work must be carefully researched, fact-checked, edited, and improved by you. We are not looking for someone who submits unedited AI-generated content. You will be responsible for the accuracy, originality, tone, and overall quality of everything you produce.



Please include the following in your application:



- A short introduction about yourself and your writing experience

- Confirmation that you have at least 5 years of professional copywriting, content writing, or related experience

- A link to your portfolio or writing samples

- Examples of website copy, articles,
s, social media content, advertisements, or video scripts you have written

- A brief description of the industries and audiences you have written for

- Details about your experience with SEO and research-based content

- The writing, research, editing, SEO, and AI tools you are comfortable using

- Your expected monthly salary in USD

- Your availability and preferred working hours



Please make sure your application and writing samples represent your own skills and accurately reflect the quality of work you can produce.



We are located in New York, United States, and operate on Eastern Time (ET, UTC/GMT -4). Full overlap with our time zone is not required, but we would like at least a few hours of overlap with our team each day.



This role will be required to use the TimeProof application to track and log all hours worked. Payments will be processed weekly through Payoneer for all hours worked during that week.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant to the President
description:
# Virtual Executive Assistant to the President



**IronHold Asset Management**

**Full-Time | Remote | Independent Contractor**

**Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time**

**Compensation: $9 to $12 USD per hour**



## About IronHold Asset Management



IronHold Asset Management is a growing real estate investment and property management company operating a multifamily portfolio across the Midwest and Southwest.



We are in an active growth phase, building the systems, team, and operating structure needed to support our expanding portfolio. We run lean, move quickly, and expect every tea
mber to take ownership of their responsibilities.



We are hiring a full-time Virtual Executive Assistant to directly support our President, Amber Hendrickson.



This is not a general virtual assistant position or a shared administrative role. You will support one executive, learn how she works, and help her stay ahead of communication, follow-ups, meetings, and operational priorities.



## Why This Role Exists



Amber oversees day-to-day operations across IronHold’s portfolio. She works closely with property managers, maintenance leaders, vendors, candidates, executives, and ownership partners.



The volume of assignments, conversations, follow-ups, and open tasks has outgrown what one person can manage alone.



We need someone who can receive an assignment, understand the desired outcome, independently move the work forward, and keep Amber informed as it progresses.



Your primary responsibility will be helping Amber stay organized, protecting her time, and ensuring that important tasks and commitments do not fall through the cracks.



## What You Will Own



### Task Management and Follow-Through



* Maintain an accurate and current task-management system for Amber

* Track assignments involving property managers, vendors, candidates, and internal tea
mbers

* Follow up on overdue tasks, unanswered questions, and incomplete commitments

* Make sure action items are assigned, documented, and completed

* Identify stalled items before they become urgent problems

* Provide Amber with concise updates on progress, delays, and issues

* Continue moving assignments forward without waiting to be reminded



### Calendar and Time Management



* Manage Amber’s calendar and scheduling

* Coordinate internal and external meetings

* Protect focus time and resolve scheduling conflicts

* Confir
etings and communicate schedule changes

* Ensure Amber knows what is coming next and has the information she needs

* Help prioritize competing requests for her time



### Inbox and Communication Management



* Review and organize Amber’s inbox daily

* Flag messages requiring her attention or decision

* Draft responses to routine messages

* Track unanswered
s and outstanding requests

* Communicate professionally with property managers, vendors, candidates, executives, and other stakeholders on Amber’s behalf

* Use sound judgment to determine what can be handled independently and what should be escalated



### Property Operations Coordination



* Support communication between Amber and IronHold’s property management teams

* Track priorities and assignments across multiple properties

* Follow up with property managers regarding deadlines, reports, operational issues, and action items

* Help Amber maintain visibility across the portfolio without requiring her to personally chase every update

* Organize recurring information and updates from property teams

* Escalate delays, risks, or recurring problems promptly



### Meeting Preparation and Follow-Through



* Prepare agendas, notes, documents, and briefing materials

* Capture decisions, assignments, owners, and deadlines during meetings

* Distribute action items after meetings

* Follow up with responsible parties until assignments are completed

* Maintain organized records from recurring meetings

* Ensure previous commitments are reviewed at the next appropriate meeting



### Hiring Coordination



* Organize candidate pipelines for property-level and corporate positions

* Schedule interviews with candidates and hiring managers

* Track each candidate’s status and required next steps

* Organize resumes, interview notes, assessments, and related documentation

* Communicate scheduling details and updates to candidates

* Help ensure candidates receive timely and professional communication



### Document and File Management



* Organize files and folders in Dropbox, Google Drive, and other shared systems

* Format reports, correspondence, presentations, and internal documents

* Maintain recurring operational documents

* Gather information needed for basic reports and updates

* Ensure important documents are current, organized, and easy to locate



### Travel and Occasional Personal Assistance



* Coordinate travel for site visits, conferences, and business trips

* Manage reservations, confirmations, itineraries, and schedule changes

* Assist with occasional personal administrative tasks as needed



## What Success Looks Like



### Within 30 Days



* You understand Amber’s working style, priorities, recurring meetings, and communication preferences

* You have taken ownership of her calendar

* You have established an effective process for organizing her inbox

* You have created a working system for tracking assignments and follow-ups

* Amber can clearly see what is moving, what is delayed, and what requires her attention



### Within 60 Days



* Meeting preparation and follow-up consistently run through you

* You independently manage recurring responsibilities

* Property managers and tea
mbers recognize you as a reliable point of coordination

* Amber is no longer personally chasing routine updates and incomplete tasks

* You communicate progress without being asked for updates



### Within 90 Days



* You anticipate recurring needs before being asked

* You identify potential problems early

* Amber trusts you to communicate and coordinate on her behalf

* Fewer assignments, commitments, and follow-ups fall through the cracks

* You have created meaningful additional capacity for the President



## Who Will Thrive in This Role



You may be a strong fit if:



* You are exceptionally organized

* An unfinished task or unanswered request bothers you until it is resolved

* You can receive an assignment and independently determine the next steps

* You know how to keep an executive informed without overwhelming them

* You communicate directly, clearly, and professionally

* You are comfortable following up persistently with busy people

* You stay calm when priorities change

* You can manage multiple open assignments without losing track of details

* You use sound judgment with confidential information

* You identify problems early rather than waiting for them to become emergencies

* You are comfortable receiving direct feedback

* You take ownership of outcomes, not just activities

* You are willing to ask thoughtful questions when instructions or priorities are unclear



## Experience and Qualifications



* Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or similar role is preferred

* Experience directly supporting a senior executive is preferred

* Experience in real estate, property management, hospitality, construction, or another operations-heavy business is helpful but not required

* Excellent spoken and written English is required

* Strong calendar, inbox, task-management, and follow-up skills are required

* The ability to work independently is required

* Strong professional judgment and discretion are required

* Experience communicating with managers, vendors, candidates, and executives is preferred

* Experience with Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Dropbox, or similar systems is preferred

* AppFolio experience is helpful but not required

* The ability to learn new systems quickly is required



## Technology Requirements



The selected contractor must provide:



* Their own reliable computer

* A stable, high-speed internet connection

* A professional and quiet remote workspace

* A functioning webcam and professional headset

* A reliable backup plan for internet or power interruptions

* The ability to participate professionally in video meetings



## Schedule and Availability



* Full-time, 40 hours per week

* Monday through Friday

* 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time

* Includes a one-hour unpaid meal break

* The selected contractor must be available and responsive during Amber’s working hours

* This position generally follows the U.S. business and holiday calendar

* Requests involving major national holidays in the contractor’s home country may be discussed in advance



## Location



This is a fully remote position.



Candidates may apply from any country, provided they:



* Have excellent spoken and written English

* Can consistently work the required Central Time schedule

* Have reliable technology and internet access

* Can communicate professionally with a U.S.-based team



## Compensation and Engagement



* $9 to $10 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability

* Expected schedule of 40 hours per week

* Approximately $1,560 to $1,733 USD per month, depending on the hourly rate and number of working days

* Paid time off, holidays, bonuses, and other arrangements are negotiable

* This position is structured as an independent-contractor engagement

* The selected contractor is responsible for providing their own equipment and workspace



## Our Hiring Process



Our hiring process is designed to evaluate communication, judgment, organization, follow-through, and compatibility with Amber’s working style.



Selected candidates may complete:



1. Application and resume review

2. Brief video introduction

3. Written screening questions

4. Initial interview

5. Paid practical work exercise

6. Leadership interview

7. Working Genius assessment for finalists

8. Working session with Amber

9. Reference checks and final offer



The Working Genius assessment is completed only by finalists. It helps us understand how each candidate’s natural strengths align with the role, but it does not replace demonstrated ability or professional judgment.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



* Your current resume

* A brief written introduction explaining why this role fits your experience

* A two-minute video introducing yourself

* Your requested hourly rate in U.S. dollars

* Confirmation that you can consistently work Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time

* A description of your computer, internet connection, and backup plan

* A brief example of a task or project you independently managed from assignment through completion

* A description of the system you use to track follow-ups and open tasks



In your introduction video, please address:



1. What type of executive do you work best with?

2. How do you keep an executive informed without requiring them to manage you?

3. How do you handle people who do not respond to your first request?

4. What do you do when you have several urgent assignments at the same time?



To demonstrate attention to detail, include the phrase **“Protect Amber’s Time”** in your written application.



IronHold Asset Management provides equal opportunities to qualified applicants. Hiring decisions are based on experience, skills, communication, professional judgment, and the requirements of the role.

Expert-level NetSuite proficiency. This is non-negotiable. You must be fluent in the GL, subledgers, inventory modules, reconciliation tools, financial reporting, and saved searches. You will be asked to walk through your NetSuite experience in detail

5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including full ownership of a monthly close

 what content should be made, develop concepts, and make sure every creator we manage always has a fresh, well-planned stream of content that fits their persona. You understand that no two creators are the same: what works for one won't work for another, and your job is to find the angle, theme, and concept that fits each one.

You will turn a creator's persona and audience into concrete content ideas and content plans, make sure there's always enough content in the pipeline, and jump in when specific content is requested to figure out what's needed and brief it clearly. You use AI (primarily Claude) as a creative partner to ideate, structure, and scale your output fast.

The ideal candidate is an idea machine — someone who genuinely understands what audiences want to see, thinks in concepts and formats rather than just tasks, and can adapt their creative instinct to completely different creators without missing a beat. You live and breathe social media: you spend time on it, you enjoy it, and you're constantly noticing trends, formats, and ideas you could pull from.

This role is for people who are extremely creative — full stop. If you find creative work difficult, or if it takes you a very long time to come up with ideas that actually stand out from the crowd, this is not the role for you, and we ask that you don't apply. We're looking for someone for whom original ideas come naturally and fast.

Exceptional creativity — you can generate strong, original content ideas on demand and adapt them to very different creators. This is non-negotiable.

description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn’t exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation’s largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we’re actively building — and leading.

Our technology: We’re actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready.

The Marketing Coordinator (Remote) supports the US-based marketing team in executing and managing digital campaigns that drive lead generation, brand visibility, and sales pipeline for MP1 Solutions. This role is responsible for day-to-day campaign execution, marketing automation, content coordination, and performance reporting across multiple digital channels.  copy, graphics, CTAs) are delivered on time and meet brand standards. Light copywriting and proofreading required.

 template editing

title: Senior Shopify Measurement Specialist — GA4 & Server-Side GTM
description:
Put Malachit in your first line so I know you read this fully.



THE PROBLEM (straight up):

We run an established German ecommerce Shopify store. Our GA4 and our Shopify storefront analytics disagree by 20-30x on traffic from one country — and that traffic produces zero revenue and behaves nothing like our real customers. We have completed an internal investigation and documented our observations. We are now looking for an independent specialist to review the evidence, challenge our thinking where appropriate, and recommend the safest path forward.



This is a diagnosis-and-fix engagement, NOT a pixel-install job. If your GA4 experience stops at Shopify's native integration, this isn't for you.



OUR STACK:

Shopify · GA4 (multiple data streams) · Google Tag Manager (web + server-side) · Stape · Shopify Customer Events / custom pixel · Google & YouTube sales channel · Google Ads, Meta, Pinterest downstream.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU:

- Review our evidence package (screenshots + data).

- Tell us what the evidence proves, what it only suggests, and what it doesn't support.

- Identify the most likely explanation — and be honest about your confidence level.

- Implement the agreed solution once the most likely explanation has been validated, with a written rationale, a config backup taken first, and post-change validation.

- HARD REQUIREMENT: no change may risk Googlebot crawl access or indexing. Non-negotiable.



WE VALUE EVIDENCE-BASED DISAGREEMENT. You will NOT be penalized for concluding our internal investigation is wrong — you'll be rewarded for it, IF you show the evidence behind your position. We're not hiring someone to agree with us. We're hiring someone to help us determine what the evidence supports.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Deep hands-on GA4 (DebugView, Realtime, data streams, data filters; BigQuery export a plus)

- GTM web AND server-side (Stape or equivalent)

- Shopify Customer Events / custom pixels

- Real experience separating genuine traffic from bot / crawler / analytics-spam patterns

- Experience communicating technical findings to non-technical business stakeholders is highly valued



TO APPLY — answer these 3 things (no answers = no review):



1. Below are five observations from a GA4 property. Rank your top 3 hypotheses from most to least likely, based only on the evidence provided, include your confidence level for each, and for your #1, name the single fastest way to confirm or kill it:

   - GA4 shows ~2,500 sessions/month from a country the store doesn't advertise in; Shopify's own analytics shows ~100 for the same period.

   - That traffic: 91% desktop (market is mobile-first), ~0% engagement, EUR 0 revenue.

   - Server-side (Stape) logs show 0 requests from that country on the one day sampled.

   - The GA4 property has two active data streams.

   - 100% of the sessions report the store's own hostname.



2. Describe one time you refused to make a change to a live production tracking setup until you'd validated something first. What was it?



3. Based on the information currently available, what would be your expected fixed-fee range (or hourly rate) for this project? We understand this is preliminary — the final scope and fixed fee will be mutually agreed after the technical assessment and before any implementation begins.



TERMS:

Fixed-scope, fixed-fee consulting engagement. One-time gig. Remote, async-friendly, with one live screen-share to walk through your findings before touching production. Production changes will only be made after approval from the store owner. Selected candidates will receive a technical assessment based on an evidence package.



We are looking for one specialist who values careful investigation over quick assumptions. If that describes how you work, we'd love to hear from you.

REQUIREMENTS:

- Quiet environment to work



TECH REQUIREMENTS (MINIMUM):

CPU: Intel i7 / Ryzen 7 / Apple M1 or better (or equivalent)

title: M&A Operations Associate / Executive Right-Hand: M&A Advisory Firm (UK, USA, UAE)
description:
Full-time | Remote | UK business hours overlap required | Long-term role | Base salary + deal success bonuses



WHO WE ARE

We're 5D Capital Partners, a fast-moving M&A advisory firm operating across the UK, US, and UAE, helping business owners buy and sell companies in the $500K–$5M EBITDA range. Small team, high standards, zero bureaucracy. We move fast and we expect the same.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This is NOT a task-taker role. We are looking for an exceptional all-rounder who takes full ownership. Someone who sees what needs doing, figures it out, and gets it done to a standard we don't have to check.

The founder currently does too much himself. Your job is to take work off his plate permanently, not to hand it back with questions. You'll be trusted with real deal work, including speaking directly with business owners, buyers and advisers. If you need step-by-step instructions for everything, this is not the role for you. If you love being trusted with responsibility and running with it, keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



- M&A calls: joining and eventually leading calls with business owners, buyers and intermediaries; screening enquiries, gathering deal information, booking and following up meetings

- Deal support: preparing and formatting proposals, Information Memorandums, engagement letters and client documents to a polished, professional standard

- Deal admin and pipeline: managing deals, contacts and follow-ups in our CRM (GoHighLevel); keeping every deal moving and nothing slipping

- Research: company research, buyer research, market and sector research for live deals

- Executive support: inbox and calendar management, scheduling, keeping the founder organised and ahead of deadlines

- Content operations: scheduling and publishing content for our weekly YouTube show and social channels; coordinating with our video editor

- Systems and SOPs: following (and improving) our documented processes as the business grows

- Anything else that lands: you pick things up fast and deliver



OUR STACK (experience with some of these is a big plus)

Notion, GoHighLevel, n8n, Google Workspace, Canva, Excel/Sheets, ChatGPT/Claude and other AI tools. If you already use AI daily to work faster, tell us. We want that.



YOU ARE



- An outstanding spoken communicator: fluent, confident, professional English on calls with business owners and investors. This is essential.

- Exceptionally high standards: you notice details others miss and you're embarrassed by sloppy work

- A fast learner: you can be handed something you've never done before and deliver it well within days, not weeks

- An owner, not an order-taker: you flag problems before they happen, propose solutions, and close loops without being chased

- Super positive and proactive: great energy, no drama, solution-focused

- Confident and well-presented on video calls: you will be client-facing

- Commercially sharp: you understand (or can quickly learn) how business acquisitions work. Experience in M&A, finance, banking, real estate or B2B sales is a strong plus.

- Reliable: stable internet, quiet workspace, consistent availability during UK business hours

- Trustworthy: you'll handle confidential deal information; discretion is non-negotiable



WHAT WE OFFER



- Base salary of Php 80,000– Php 120,000/month depending on experience ($1,300-$1,950/month)

- Deal success bonuses: when deals we're working on complete, you share in the win

- 13th month pay

- Full-time, long-term role with a growing international firm

- Genuine responsibility and growth: as we scale, you scale with us

- Direct access to the founders; no layers, no politics

- Paid Philippine holidays after probation



HOW TO APPLY

We get a lot of applications and we filter hard for attention to detail:



- Start your application with the word "ANCHOR" so we know you read this far.

- Record a 2–3 minute video introduction telling us why you're an exceptional fit, including a specific example of a time you took ownership of something outside your job description and nailed it. This is required, not optional. We cannot assess you for a client-facing role without hearing you speak.

- List the tools from our stack you've used, and your proficiency with each.

- Tell us about any experience with M&A, finance, sales or client-facing work.

- Include your expected monthly salary and your available working hours (in UK time).



Applications that don't follow these instructions will not be read. If you follow them well, you'll hear from us fast.



Thanks,

Mike

title: Graphic Designer for a 30-Year Volleyball Brand
description:
Graphic Designer for a 30-Year Volleyball Brand (Pure Design, No Ads Knowledge Needed)



TYPE OF WORK: Any

WAGE / SALARY: Negotiable, you name your price

HOURS PER WEEK: 30



JOB OVERVIEW



All Volleyball has been selling to the U.S. volleyball community for over 30 years. Shoes, apparel, balls, and team gear, for athletes, clubs, and fans across the country. Real products, real customers, real budgets behind the creative.



The company runs on a Filipino team. That was a hiring decision, not a cost decision. Our designers, editors, and marketing staff are Filipino, and several of them have been with us for years. They stayed because the briefs are clear, the pay arrives when we say it will, and nobody here gets treated as disposable for being remote.



We are opening our search for the next designer to join them, and we want to hear from you before we d
 anything about titles, hours, or contracts.



WHY WE THINK YOU WILL WANT THIS



Most design jobs on this site ask you to be four people at once. Designer, media buyer, video editor, strategist, all for one rate. We are doing the opposite.



You do not need to know Meta ads. You do not need to understand hook rates, CTR, CPA, or funnels, and we will never ask you about them. We have people for that already. What we need from you is design, done at a level most companies never get near.



Here is what the job actually looks like:



1 - You get real products to work with. Volleyball shoes, jerseys, balls, team gear, photographed properly, waiting for someone to make them look like something



2 - Your work ships. It goes out to a national audience of athletes and clubs who buy from us, not into a folder nobody opens



3 - You name your price. We do not post a rate because we do not pay a rate, we pay a person. Tell us what you are worth

and back it up with your work



4 - You get paid through Wise, quickly, without chasing anyone. Ask any Filipino freelancer how rare that is



5 - Do well and you earn more. The people who deliver here have watched their rates climb, because we would rather pay someone good than go looking for someone new



6 - You talk directly to our marketing manager in Slack. No account managers, no layers, no telephone game between you and the person who d



There is creative freedom here, and there is also direction, which means you will never be guessing what we want and you will never be micromanaged while you do it.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Taste, mostly. The rest can be taught.



1 - A strong eye for layout, type, color, hierarchy, and spacing



2 - Real fluency in Figma, Photoshop, or Illustrator. One of them, used well, is enough



3 - Comfort with AI tools like Photoshop AI, Firefly, or Midjourney to move faster



4 - Someone who can look at a raw product photo on a white background and already see the finished piece



5 - Someone who knows why one layout breathes and another feels cramped, and fixes it without being asked



6 - You take feedback and revise without ego



7 - Strong English and clear written communication



Experience with sports or performance brands helps. We do not require it. If your portfolio has one piece in it that you are quietly proud of, we want to see that piece.



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY



We will save you the time. If you send the same template to forty job posts, if your portfolio is stock mockups, or if you need someone standing over you to get work finished, we are not going to be a fit. Everyone else, keep reading.



HOW TO APPLY:



This part is short on purpose. We want to see your work before we ask anything else of you.



Send us:



1 - A short introduction about yourself and your background as a designer



2 - Your portfolio. A link, a PDF, a Google Drive folder, whatever you already have. Do not build something new for us



3 - The one piece in it you are most proud of, and one sentence on why



4 - The tools you work in, including any AI tools



5 - What you would want to be paid. Monthly, hourly, or per project. Be direct. We will not be offended, and we will not lowball you for answering honestly



That is the whole application. No test, no spec work, no assignment.



If we like what we see, we will reach out personally, tell you exactly what the work and the money look like, and take it from there. Everyone who applies with a real portfolio and a real rate gets looked at by a person, not a filter.



BEFORE YOU GO



We have teammates who have been here five, six, and seven years.



That does not happen by a
. It happens because we are honest about what we expect, we pay on time, and we treat skilled people like the asset they are.



If you are a designer who has been waiting for a brand that cares about the design itself, and a team of Filipinos who take real pride in their craft, send us your work. We read every application.



FILL OUT THIS FORM: 



SKILL REQUIREMENT: Design, Graphic Design, Photoshop

title: Head of Contact Center Operations - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Head of Contact Center Operations is the senior execution leader of MedPro and MP1's contact center — the person who makes the operation run, improves it continuously, and manages the managers who manage the floor. You report to the VP of Operations and translate their strategic direction into daily operational reality.



This role sits at the intersection of operator and thought partner. You have done this before: run high-volume, multi-channel service environments, built capacity plans between labor and systems, designed operating models from the ground up, and led teams through system migrations without losing service continuity. You are not here to hold the org steady — you are here to elevate it.



Where the VP of Operations sets the vision, you own delivery. When the VP of Operations needs to present performance to the COO, the data, the narrative, and the operational confidence behind it come from you. When the organization needs its service processes redesigned, its CRM environment assessed, or its team structure rebuilt — that work belongs to you.



Key Responsibilities:

Multi-Layer Team Leadership & People Development

• Lead, coach, and develop Operations Managers and Team Leads — you manage the managers, and they manage the floor. Build leaders who build others.

• Establish clear performance expectations, coaching cadences, and accountability frameworks across all leadership levels — weekly 1:1s, call calibrations, structured performance reviews, and real-time feedback loops.

• Drive workforce planning and capacity modeling: design the right staffing structure between labor, channels, and volume patterns — not just fill headcount, but engineer capacity.

• Build succession plans and internal development pathways that reduce external hiring dependency and create a promotion pipeline from within.

• Own recruitment strategy for the operations team in partnership with HR — attract, hire, and retain the caliber of leader and frontline talent that the CSO model demands.

• Foster a performance culture aligned to MedPro's values: Do the Right Thing, Figure It Out, Win as a Team, and Accountability & Ownership.



Operating Model Design & Service Delivery

• Assess the current state of the contact center operation — people, process, structure, channels, and systems — and translate findings into a clear-eyed redesign plan with sequenced priorities.

• Design and implement the operating model: how the team is structured, how work flows through channels, how performance is governed, and how the organization scales as the client base grows.

• Own day-to-day operational performance across all service channels — inbound and outbound voice,
, chat, and SMS — with direct accountability for SLA attainment, handle time, first-contact resolution, and quality scores.

• Build and maintain the full SOP and playbook library: every process documented, auditable, and owned. If it is not written down, it does not exist.

• Own the quality assurance framework — define rubrics, conduct or oversee audits, deliver structured coaching feedback to leads, and use quality data to drive continuous improvement.

• Manage real-time workload distribution across channels — monitor queues, adjust staffing deployment as volume shifts, and act on performance signals without waiting to be asked.



System Assessment & Service Technology Migration

• Conduct a thorough assessment of the current CRM and service technology environment — understanding what exists, what is working, what is limiting, and what migration path forward best serves the operation.

• Lead the end-to-end service system migration: requirements gathering, vendor evaluation, workflow configuration, data mapping, agent training, parallel testing, and go-live — while maintaining service continuity throughout.

• Design and configure case management workflows, escalation paths, SLA tracking, and omni-channel routing logic in the new system, aligned to MedPro's service model and client base.

• Partner with the internal technology team to ensure all system integrations — IVR handoffs, client account data, ticketing — flow cleanly from day one.

• Build post-migration operating model documentation: how cases are created, routed, resolved, escalated, and reported — so no process lives in someone's head.

• Drive full agent and Team Lead adoption: training materials, live coaching sessions, compliance monitoring, and performance metrics in the new system until it is the single active system of record.

• Design, build, and maintain IVR call flows that intelligently route clients, reduce handle time, and improve containment — build these, not just manage ones that already exist.



Performance Management, Data & Reporting

• Own the KPI framework — define the right metrics, build the dashboards, and drive accountability systems that make performance visible and improvable at every level of the team.

• Deliver structured weekly and monthly performance reports to the VP of Operations — covering channel SLA attainment, CSAT trends, quality scores, case volume, and system migration status.

• Translate floor-level data into operational decisions and clear narrative: what is driving variance, what specific action will improve it, and what the risk is if it is not addressed.

• Communicate proactively to the VP of Operations about service risks, capacity issues, and migration blockers — full transparency, solution-first framing, no surprises that should have been visible earlier.

• Identify and scope AI-assist and automation opportunities (IVR containment, agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection) — bring the VP of Operations a prioritized business case, not just ideas.



Client Experience & Regulatory Compliance

• Own the client experience at the operational level — serving as the escalation point for complex service issues and ensuring every client interaction reflects MedPro and MP1's positioning as a true compliance partner.

• Map and continuously improve the client journey across all contact touchpoints — identifying friction, closing gaps, and driving measurable improvements in client satisfaction scores.

• Ensure operational adherence to all applicable data security, privacy, and healthcare regulatory requirements including HIPAA and related standards.

• Partner with Sales and Client Success to align operational delivery with client growth, renewal, and expansion strategies.



Qualifications:

Required

• 10–15 years of total experience in contact center operations, service delivery, or BPO leadership — with significant, demonstrable accountability for team performance, service transformation, and operational change.

• Minimum 5 years in a senior people-management role with direct accountability for multi-layer teams (managers managing managers), department-level KPIs, and operational planning. Candidates who have only managed frontline teams — and not managed managers — will not be a fit.

• Proven experience operating in high-volume, multi-channel service environments with large numbers of customer interactions across voice,
, chat, and digital touchpoints. This is an execution role — we need someone who has run the floor at volume, not just designed programs from above it.

• Demonstrated experience leading a service system migration in a live contact center — transitioning a team from a legacy CRM to a modern platform while maintaining service continuity. Salesforce Service Cloud experience is strongly preferred.

• Hands-on capacity planning expertise: ability to model the right labor structure against channel mix, volume forecasts, and SLA requirements — and build the operating model that delivers it.

• Deep IVR design and multi-channel routing experience — you have built IVR flows from scratch, configured routing logic, and measured containment impact.

• Strong analytical capability — builds and interprets dashboards, identifies performance drivers, and communicates findings clearly to senior leadership.

• Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills for daily interaction with U.S.-based leadership.

• Background in healthcare BPO, compliance services, regulated service industries, or U.S.-facing contact center operations strongly preferred.



Nice-to-Have

• Salesforce Service Cloud proficiency — case management, workflow rules, SLA configuration, omni-channel routing, and reporting.

• Experience with AI-assist tools in contact center settings: agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection, predictive routing.

• Workforce management platform experience (NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, or similar).

• HIPAA familiarity and/or exposure to U.S. healthcare regulatory compliance operations.

• Track record of building or rebuilding operations within a high-growth or category-defining company.

• Six Sigma, COPC, or equivalent contact center quality certification.



Compensation & Benefits:

• Salary Range: $18-$24/hr 

• Permanent work-from-home

• 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST, graveyard shift).

• Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work with pay on US Holidays

• Paid Leaves after 6 months of employment!



Basic Technical Requirements:

• Your own laptop/desktop PC with the following minimum specs: i5 5th gen and above/AMD equivalent; 8GB RAM; Mozilla or Chrome installed; Windows 10 upwards.

• A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps

• With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply

• Noise-canceling headset/headphones

• A quiet and dedicated workspace at home



Application Process:

1. Your most updated resume.



2. Submit to all of these
s:

MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: AI Engineer (Python, agents, evals). Project-based, must be near Makati
description:
Read this first and save yourself the time

I'm not hiring a virtual assistant. I'm not hiring anyone to wire apps together in n8n or Zapier.

I want one AI engineer who can build AI systems that work every time instead of most of the time, and who's willing to do it in a room with me watching here in Makati.

If that isn't you, you can close this.

Who I am

40yrs+ in marketing, sales, and running businesses. I'm currently building an AI marketing association. The strategy is done. The offer is done. The course is almost done.

What's left is production. Content production is the current bottleneck.

The problem I'm trying to solve

Almost everything I sell is text. Course scripts, course materials, etc.

We already draft with AI. That part works fine. The bottleneck is what happens after. Somebody sits down and reads every single line, catching the same mistakes over and over again.

That's the most expensive hour in my business, and it's being spent on things a machine (AI workflow/AI agent) should have caught before a human ever opened the file.

What I want built

An editing pipeline. Four parts, in this order.

Deterministic checks run first, written in code. Words we never use. Punctuation we don't allow. Sentence patterns we don't allow. Length. No model involved, no cost, instant

What survives goes to a critic model. It compares the draft against work we've already approved and it reports what it finds

A second model holds the context and d
 what to change. The critic doesn't get to rewrite anything

The loop is bounded. It stops on its own. Then a human reads what came out

The goal is not to remove the human. The goal is that when my editor opens the file, she's fixing a few lines to make it sound human, instead of rebuilding the whole thing. Put the word bounded as the first line of your reply so I know you read this far. Where exactly that line sits, we figure out together once you're in.

Once that pipeline works, there's more of the same kind of work. Lead magnets, documents, and every other place where I'm paying a person to do something a machine could have done first.

Who I think can help me

This is not a checklist. Recognize yourself in most of it and apply.

You've shipped software that other people actually used

You've built something real with AI, and it has burned you at least once. You know what it cost you

You know why a thing that works 9 times out of 10 is not the same as a thing that works. And you can tell me what closes that gap

Something you built broke while nobody was watching. You went and found out why, and you fixed it so it never broke that way again

You know when a job doesn't need AI at all. If the steps are the same every time, you write ten lines of code and it runs for free, forever

You're fine being watched and interrupted while you work

You can tell a client "I don't know, give me a minute," and it doesn't bother you

You'll notice I haven't listed one required tool. Because all I care about is the result. It's nice if your workflow revolves around Claude and Claude Code, but bring whatever stack gets the job done. 
 experience is a small plus but not required.

Who this isn't for

If n8n and Zapier are the only tools you know, this isn't for you. If they're two tools out of many you know, that's a plus

You teach AI. You post about AI, you make courses about AI, but you haven't built something real that other people used

Machine learning and data science people. I'm not training a model

Anyone who needs a full-time salary. This is project work

How this works

Project-based and paid. Nobody works for free here and nobody works for exposure

It opens with one working session. 5 hours, in person, Makati, on a weekend (Saturday)

PHP 5,000 for that session. I send it by GCash the same day, before you go home

Bring your laptop. I hand you one real piece of my copy and the style guide. You build one check and one model call against it. That's the whole test

You keep the money whether or not we go further

The Makati session is not negotiable. Everything after it can be remote, on your own hours, around whatever else you've got going on. But I'm going to sit next to whoever builds this at least once before I hand him anything. If you can't make that happen, we won't work out, and it's better we both know now.

How to apply

Answer these five in your reply. Don't send a CV. I'll ask for one if we get that far.

Tell me about a time you d
 not to build an agent, and what you built instead

Something you built that ran unattended. What broke, how did you find out, and what did you change so it never broke that way again

I want this pipeline to hand my editor something that needs light polish, not a rebuild. How would you know it's doing that? And how would you know if it quietly stopped doing that?

* Stable workload

* Premium international brands

title: Controller
description:
Ikigai Cases is hiring a Controller!

Location: Remote / Work From Home

Reports to: CEO





About the Company

Ikigai Cases (
) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe. 



Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail.





About the Role

We are hiring a Controller to take complete ownership of our financial operations - accounting, reporting, payroll, budgeting, cash flow, tax coordination, and financial systems. This is a critical senior role, and we’re looking for someone whose professional identity is built around three things: the integrity of the numbers, running the finance function end-to-end, and providing strategic financial insight to the CEO.



The ideal candidate has served as a Controller (or equivalent) for an e-commerce or DTC brand in the $10–30M revenue range. You understand the financial rhythms of e-commerce: Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow swings, sales tax across multiple states, and the speed at which decisions need to be made. If you’ve done this before at a similar-sized company, you already know what we need.



We need someone who builds systems, not just operates inside them. You’ll report directly to the CEO and work hand-in-hand with our external financial advisor. No layers of management between you and the decisions your work supports.









Core Responsibilities

Monthly Close & Financial Reporting: Close books by the 10th of every month. Produce reviewed P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements in Finaloop. Resolve misclassifications proactively. Maintain a clean chart of accounts. No CEO intervention required.



Budgeting & Financial Planning: Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets. Own budget vs. actuals: produce variance reports monthly alongside the P&L close with plain-language explanations. Update balance sheet items and expenses weekly inside the company’s financial models.



Cash Flow Management & Forecasting: Maintain the 13-week cash flow forecast weekly and proactively. Flag upcoming cash movements, exposure, and risks before they become surprises. This is one of the most critical tools the CEO uses for capital allocation.



Payroll Operations (Zero-Error Standard): Own bi-weekly payroll across ADP (US) and Deel (Philippines). Submit the morning of payroll day, every cycle. PTO, overtime, and deductions captured before submission. You catch discrepancies before they reach the CEO.



Tax Coordination & Compliance: Own the relationship with Numeral on multi-state sales tax filings. Maintain the estimated tax payment tracker. Coordinate with our external CPA on annual filings. Flag tax exposure and timing proactively.

Vendor Payments, Disbursements & Financial Systems: Execute and double-check all vendor payments (Venmo, PayPal, wire). Track owner distributions and related-party transactions. Manage Finaloop, Shopify revenue reconciliation, and Google Sheets financial modeling. Manage financial admin including insurance, vendor accounts, and benefits.



CEO Reporting & Ad Hoc Analysis: Weekly: 13WCF update, flagged variances, upcoming cash movements. Monthly: clean financial statements with brief narrative. As needed: ad hoc financial analysis without requiring a detailed spec.



Why You Should Take This Role

-You’ll work at a brand obsessed with its customers, with a loyal following. Read the reviews: 

-A company that’s scaled rapidly in 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth.

-You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain.

-The company was founded to solve a personal problem - Tavish’s father battled a neurological condition for a decade and the family discovered the issues with plastic pill organizers.

-You’ll own the entire financial function for a company on a trajectory from $11.5M to $30M - a career-defining role for the right person.





Required Experience & Skills

-5+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations

-Prior Controller or senior finance role at a company doing $10M+ in annual revenue - you’ve owned the full financial function, not just pieces of it

-E-commerce or DTC company experience strongly preferred - Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow, multi-state sales tax

-Experience closing books independently, on a monthly cadence, without supervision

-Demonstrated accuracy record - you should be able to speak to this specifically

-US GAAP familiarity (CPA not required, but you must understand the principles)

-Experience preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets

-Payroll experience across multiple platforms

-Advanced Google Sheets / Excel (SUMIFS, financial modeling, pivot tables)

-Strong proficiency with Finaloop, QuickBooks Online, or equivalent cloud accounting platform

-Strong written and verbal English; ability to explain financial insights to non-financial stakeholders





Nice-to-Have Experience

* Strong English reading and writing skills required

 subject:

* Tekmetric

* PartsTech

* TireHub

* TireCo

* ALLDATA

* Identifix

title: Content Specialist
description:
About Fusion Vine

Fusion Vine is a remote-first company focused on building efficient, scalable systems that help businesses grow through smart operations, content, and digital execution. We specialize in combining human talent with AI-powered workflows to deliver high-quality results at scale.



Our team values clarity, accountability, continuous improvement, and performance-based growth. We work with clear processes, defined expectations, and a strong focus on outcomes.



Role Overview

Fusion Vine is hiring a Content Specialist to help scale content production through AI-assisted workflows. This role is ideal for motivated writers who can combine strong English skills with critical thinking and smart use of AI tools. Entry-level candidates are welcome: if you can think critically and move fast, we can work with you.



Key Goal

Produce high-quality, accurate, and well-structured content at speed: using AI as a tool, not a shortcut: while maintaining clarity, brand voice, and defined quality standards.



Responsibilities

Write and deliver content using AI models as a writing aid, not a replacement for judgment

Critically review and refine AI-generated drafts for readability, accuracy, tone, and structure

Fact-check content and ensure it meets quality standards before submission

Follow content briefs, SOPs, and style guidelines closely

Complete assigned article bundles within agreed timelines

Edit for grammar, readability, and proper formatting

Stay productive and proactive: do not wait to be pushed into tasks



Requirements

Strong English proficiency: written and reading comprehension

Ability to think critically and improve AI-generated content rather than copy it blindly

Self-motivated with a strong sense of urgency and follow-through

Reliable internet connection and a suitable work device

Ability to follow instructions, briefs, and feedback closely

Critical thinking and troubleshooting is essential

Comfortable using AI tools for content creation and editing

Entry-level candidates accepted: hustle and critical thinking matter more than years of experience



Nice to Have

Foundational knowledge or genuine interest in the topics being covered

Experience with SEO content writing

Familiarity with content management systems

Background in marketing, blogs, or long-form content

Prior experience working in a remote or freelance setting



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Speed of delivery: complete article bundles quickly and on schedule (e.g., 15 articles in 2 days, not 2 weeks)

Quality of output: submit polished, reviewed content that meets defined completion criteria

Critical thinking: demonstrate genuine review and refinement of AI outputs, not blind copy-paste

Responsiveness: jump into assigned projects immediately without delay

Consistency: maintain steady, reliable output throughout the trial period and beyond



Compensation

$3.50 – $5.00 per hour

Rate determined based on experience, skills, and performance during the trial period

Piecework/bundle-based structure: payment upon completion of each assigned bundle

One-month trial period to assess fit and performance

Opportunity to increase rate and expand hours after a successful trial



Why Join Fusion Vine?

Fully remote work environment

Clear systems, expectations, and feedback from day one

Performance-based growth: your results determine your opportunities

Hands-on experience with AI-powered content workflows

Opportunity for long-term partnership if the trial goes well

Entry-level friendly: we value drive and quality output over credentials

description:
PR Manager



Do you love reaching out to publications and media to get mentions, stories, guest posts and other placements?



Do you want to help develop the brand and following for an innovative new home services solution that’s going to rock the US market?



Do you want to put together podcasts, webinars and in-person US events to raise the company’s visibility?



If this is you, we want to talk! Tempesta Media, a leader in the US residential home services marketing technology industry for the past 15 years, is launching a groundbreaking new AI-powered platform for homeowners and contractors. This is really cutting-edge stuff!



We’re seeking a talented PR Manager to build the company’s brand authority. This includes:

• Media list development and outreach

• Publication outreach and placement

• Website guest post outreach

• Podcast guest appearance booking

• Booking speaking opportunities for the company

• Awards applications and more.



This is a 100% remote position that will require some overlap with US hours – Chicago – Central Time (-06:00 GMT) for meetings, events, training, etc. The position is a part-time position that has the opportunity to grow into a full-time role. 



You must have a reliable home office setup:

• Computer with at least 8GB of RAM (16GB+ preferred)

• High-resolution camera and noise-canceling microphone

• High-speed Internet access of at least 100MB down



The performance of this role will be measured on the following growth, engagement and bottom-funnel performance. The compensation will be a combination of salary and performance- and milestone-based bonuses.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• At least 2 years of B2B PR experience.

• At least 1 year of experience pitching journalists.

• At least 1 year of experience with securing speaking and guest appearance opportunities.

• US PR experience is required.

• US home services experience is a huge plus, but not required.

• A track record of quantifiable results.

• Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment in a small company.



HOW TO APPLY

The application process is straightforward. Follow these exact steps. If you do not, your application will automatically be rejected.

1. Send your resume.

2. Send us a link to your best PR placement success. Explain why it was so great. Explain how you achieved it. Cover the performance metrics – likes, reposts, engagement, leads, sales, etc.

• How you can make an impact in this role in the first 90 days

That’s it! We’ll review your information and get back to you within 2 business days.



NOTE: We will disregard incomplete applications missing all 4 components.

This is an opportunity to build the operating system behind a rapidly growing company.



---



## What You'll Do
