title: Supply Chain & Logistics Lead (Amazon FBA Private Label Brands)
description:
** ABOUT US **



We run two complementary Amazon FBA brands: one in a premium giftable category with strong Christmas seasonality, one in sports & fitness. We are at ~200 SKUs today, with a clear roadmap to ~500. We sell on 
, .
, 
, manufacture in China, and ship into FBA, AWD, and 3PLs across the US, UK, and Canada.



** THE ROLE **



This is a senior role. The CEO and Head of Operations are looking for a trusted operator to take ownership of the supply chain and logistics function, “end-to-end”, from initial forecasting -to- factory floor -to- FBA shelf. Someone we can hand the keys to and trust to drive it forward with little oversight.



You'll inherit a well-documented operation, with a structured onboarding: our current Supply Chain Manager will support your transition, transferring knowledge of both brands, our suppliers, and our systems so you can take the reins with confidence.



We also expect you to work AI-first. The best person for this role uses AI daily: to pressure-test forecasts, draft communications, build formulas, and automate the repetitive parts of logistics coordination. At the same time, you verify every output before it touches a decision. AI leverage is how one sharp operator runs what used to take a full department.



** WHAT YOU WILL OWN **



— Supply chain strategy and execution across both brands, “end-to-end”. Each runs its own forecasting methodology; you'll master both and standardise where it genuinely helps

— Demand forecasting and order planning for 200 SKUs (scaling to 500), built in Google Sheets with the backing of solid data flows

— China manufacturer relationships: production scheduling, inspections, quality, MOQ and pricing negotiation, alternate sourcing

— International freight and logistics coordination: coordinator of carrier selection, cost vs. transit time, customs compliance, freight forwarders, 3PLs

— FBA inventory health: 45 to 90 days cover, avoiding stockouts and overstock, inbound receiving discrepancies, reimbursements, cases with Amazon

— The small, critical details: barcodes, FNSKUs, shipment labeling, compliance documentation, tracking reconciliation. You are the last line of defense

— A performance dashboard you build and own: forecast accuracy, inventory turnover, lead time, on-time-in-full, stockout rate, shipping cost per unit, cashflow planning

— Alignment with marketing and sales, so inventory matches promotional plans and seasonality. Flagged early, with numbers

— Task and process management in ClickUp: every shipment, order, supplier action, and follow-up lives in ClickUp so the whole team has visibility and nothing falls through the cracks. You will be expected to maintain it rigorously, not treat it as optional

— Proactive communication: updates prior to asking, risks flagged early, follow-through without being chased



** WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS HERE **



In supply chain management, small mistakes compound: one wrong barcode or missed reorder point can be costly. So we work to a clear standard. Sanity checking is built into how you operate: reconciling totals, second-passing formulas, and gut-checking outputs against reality before they drive a decision. Occasional errors are part of the job; what we can't carry is the same error recurring, going unnoticed, or going unexplained. When something does go wrong, you own it: what happened, why, the impact, and the fix that stops it repeating. Work like that, and you'll have our full backing when things go sideways.



** MUST HAVES: SKILLS & EXPERIENCE **



— 4+ years in supply chain, with 2+ years personally running an Amazon FBA supply chain “end-to-end” (Bachelor's in Supply Chain or related field is a plus)

— Proven experience managing 100+ SKUs; multi-brand portfolios a plus

— Deep international logistics knowledge: sea freight, customs, import/export compliance

— Strong Seller Central command: restock/capacity limits, IPI, shipment creation, FNSKU and barcode management, AWD vs. FBA 

— Advanced Google Sheets/Excel. You build models, not just populate them (array formulas,  pivot tables, QUERY, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, IMPORTRANGE). We will ask to see analyses you've built.

— Demonstrable AI fluency: real examples of AI saving you hours, and of catching it when it was wrong or hallucinating

— Experience with seasonal products and Christmas demand spikes

— Comfortable delegating and reviewing the work of others when needed

— Fluent English, written and verbal (Mandarin/Chinese a bonus for supplier communications in their native language)



** WORK SETUP **



Reliable electricity and 50+ Mbps internet, your own computer, and a quiet workspace. We run all tasks, processes, and reporting through ClickUp: it is our central hub for visibility across the team, and strong comfort with it is a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Working hours must cross over with China and UK hours (e.g. roughly 2pm to 10pm PH time, or a split shift like PHT 10am to 2pm & 6pm to 10pm). We're flexible on the shape, as long as the crossover is there.



** PERSONALITY WE'RE LOOKING FOR **



A logician's mind: structured, methodical, rigorous. Obsessively detail-oriented, so spotting an off barcode or an ambiguously worded supplier quote is your default mode, not an effort. The right fit is someone with real agency: you push for action, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and juggle parallel priorities without losing oversight of the details. An independent operator and self-starter who stays calm under pressure during peak-season spikes and shipping delays. Fully accountable. Always improving the system.



** NOT A FIT IF YOU **



— Need step-by-step instructions

— Are a generalist VA with peripheral supply chain exposure

— Have not personally managed an FBA supply chain “end-to-end”

— Find details tedious, or paste AI output without checking it

— Are juggling multiple other clients



** THE PACKAGE **



— Full-time, 40 hrs/week; bi-weekly salary (3rd and 18th of the month)

— $1,900 to $2,400/month base (PHP 120,000 to 150,000), equivalent to $11 to $14 per hour, depending on experience

— 13th-month pay, pro-rated each December

— Health reimbursement up to $50/month (HMO, PhilHealth, Maxicare, etc.)



** HOW TO APPLY **



Complete the application form below. It includes a few short questions and two brief video uploads (you can submit partially and return to finish later):



Apply via this link:

title: HR Generalist
description:
The HR Generalist is responsible for the accurate, day-to-day administration of the company’s human resources functions, with particular emphasis on payroll integrity, benefits administration, compliance, and employee lifecycle support. This is a full-time, dedicated role requiring consistent availability, meticulous attention to detail, and ownership of recurring audits and reconciliations. The HR Generalist serves as a reliable point of contact for employees and management and ensures that all HR processes are executed completely, accurately, and on schedule.



-----



## Essential Duties and Responsibilities



### Payroll & Paychex Administration



- Process and review full-cycle payroll through Paychex, ensuring accuracy of hours, rates, deductions, and tax withholdings each cycle.

- Conduct thorough, documented audits of Paychex data on a defined schedule (e.g., each pay period and monthly), reconciling discrepancies before payroll is finalized.

- Maintain accurate employee records in Paychex, including new hires, terminations, status changes, and compensation updates.

- Generate and review payroll reports, flagging anomalies and resolving issues proactively.

- Ensure payroll-related compliance filings and records are complete and submitted on time.



### Benefits Administration



- Administer employee benefits programs, including enrollments, changes, and terminations.

- Reconcile benefits invoices against enrollment records and resolve billing discrepancies.

- Serve as a resource for employee benefits questions.



### Compliance & Recordkeeping



- Maintain accurate, organized, and confidential employee files and HR documentation.

- Support compliance with applicable labor laws and internal policies.

- Assist in preparing for and responding to audits, ensuring documentation is accurate and readily available.



### Employee Lifecycle Support



- Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring all steps are completed and documented.

- Support recruitment activities as needed, including job postings, scheduling, and candidate communication.

- Respond to employee inquiries promptly and professionally.



### Reporting & Accountability



- Track and report on assigned HR metrics and deliverables.

- Provide regular status updates to the supervisor and maintain transparent records of completed work.

- Meet established deadlines and quality standards consistently.



-----



## Required Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, **or** equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Minimum **3 years** of hands-on HR generalist experience, including direct payroll processing.

- **Demonstrated, hands-on experience with Paychex** (or comparable payroll/HRIS platforms) including running and auditing payroll.

- Proven ability to perform detailed reconciliations and audits with a high degree of accuracy.

- Strong working knowledge of HR practices, payroll fundamentals, and benefits administration.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable home-office setup, and the ability to maintain a consistent full-time schedule with the required time-zone overlap.



## Preferred Qualifications



- SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or equivalent HR certification.

- Experience supporting U.S.-based employers and familiarity with U.S. payroll and compliance practices.

- Experience working remotely with distributed teams.



-----



## Core Competencies



- **Attention to Detail** — Produces accurate work and catches errors before they reach finalization.

- **Accountability & Ownership** — Takes full responsibility for assigned deliverables and follows through to completion.

- **Reliability** — Maintains consistent, full-time availability and meets commitments.

- **Integrity & Confidentiality** — Handles sensitive information with discretion.

- **Communication** — Keeps stakeholders informed with clear, timely updates.

- **Organization** — Manages multiple priorities and recurring deadlines without lapses.



-----



## Work Environment & Expectations



This is a fully remote, full-time position. The successful candidate is expected to be available and responsive during agreed working hours, maintain accurate time and activity records, and deliver work product that meets quality and timeliness standards. Performance will be evaluated against defined deliverables, audit accuracy, and adherence to schedule.

.

5+ years of personal injury litigation paralegal experience — active litigation stage experience required; pre-litigation backgrounds will not be considered

Strong working knowledge of state, local, and federal court rules

Experience with e-filing, legal documentation, and litigation management software

Exceptional English written and verbal communication skills

Highly organized with strong time-management instincts

Genuine empathy for injured clients and a client-first mindset

Professional demeanor with the confidence to exceed expectations

A collaborative spirit and desire to mentor and motivate teammates

Ability to work during US Mountain Time business hours (Mon–Thu 8–5, Fri 8–4)

A track record of long-term success and growth in previous roles is a strong plus



What You'll Do

As a Litigation Paralegal at Parnall Law, you'll be an essential force behind our attorneys — helping move cases forward with precision, compassion, and purpose. Your organizational expertise and client-focused mindset will directly shape outcomes for real people at some of the most difficult 
nts of their lives.





MISSION STATEMENT



To work together with the attorneys as a team to provide clients with intelligent, compassionate and determined advocacy, with the goal of maximizing compensation for the harms caused by wrongful actions of others.



To give clients and files the attention and organization needed to help bring resolution as effectively and quickly as possible.



To make sure that, at the end of the case, the client is satisfied and knows Parnall Law has stood up for, fought for, and given voice and value to his or her harm.



To work and motivate tea
mbers according to the values of Parnall Law Firm.



RESULTS / OUTCOMES (What you must get done.)



Attend weekly firm-wide huddle every Monday morning at 8:00

Attend daily team mini huddle Tuesday through Thursday at 8:00 am

Attend weekly calendar meetings on Fridays at 8:00 am

Have status comments entered before weekly meeting of Operations Manager and Leads.

Attend biweekly meeting with Team Lead to go over individual metrics and goals.

Draft and file complaints within 30 days of case being transferred to LIT 00.

Send out service of process within 15 days of filing complaint.

Accomplish service of process within 30 days of sending out service.

Ensure that a scheduling conference has been requested within 30 days of all defendants filing an answer to the complaint (unless the case is valued at more than $100K and attorney has chosen not to request yet).

Ensure that scheduling hearings are set within two months of the request.

Calendar all scheduling order items within 5 days of receipt of the scheduling order.

Schedule mediations within 60 days of moving a case to LDD (Litigation, Discovery, Depositions).

Providing telephonic client updates every 6 weeks and having 10 or less outstanding updates at any given time.

Ensure overdue tasks never exceed 50.



DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES



Attend Transition to Litigation meetings with client and Case Manager.

Speak to adjusters, defense attorneys, others involved in litigation.

Update client with copies of relevant file materials.

Work with legal assistant to e-file and e-serve court pleadings

Be familiar with state, local and federal rules for every jurisdiction in we practice in

Post all costs including expected costs that we have not been invoiced for (mediation, depositions, expert fees, etc.)

Draft and serve subpoenas

Compose discovery requests, answers / responses

Creating and maintaining a discovery index identifying production of all parties, by bates stamp numbers.

Review defendant discovery responses/Defendant deposition transcripts for follow up discovery

Update case analysis within one week of receiving Defendant's discovery answers with Defendant's policy limits.

Set Depositions (Request witness fee, if necessary)

Create motion/mediation and arbitration/exhibit binders

Be up-to-date with each case and work with case managers/ legal assistants to complete the background check/asset check on all Defendants and background check on clients.

Complete all attorney assignments in a timely manner.

Draft correspondence, pleadings, discovery for attorneys, save/name all documents in SmartAdvocate in accordance with Naming Protocol.

Calendar all case information pursuant to the calendaring protocol.

Perform backup intake calls in accordance with intake protocol.

Work with all staff assigned to your cases to move the case to a desired conclusion.

Posting all case information, case dates, and litigation information, in SmartAdvocate.

Prepare for trial (schedule witness statements, exhibits, UJIs, etc.)

Attend trial

Follow and maintain all firm policies and procedures.

Proportionately contribute to overall client satisfaction and firm revenue goals.

If you’re the type of person who blows people away with your work ethic, initiative, and attention to detail…



Keep reading.



?



Who I’m Looking For



A while back, I worked with someone who completely changed my expectations of what a great assistant could be.



She was incredibly fast.



She stayed organized.



She thought for herself.



She solved problems before I even noticed them.



She didn’t need constant reminders.



She didn’t wait for permission to make things better.



She simply owned her responsibilities.



That’s who I’m trying to find again.



I’m not hiring for the skills you have today.



I’m hiring for your mindset.



I can teach software.



I can teach quoting.



I can teach our systems.



I can’t teach urgency, ownership, work ethic, or initiative.



?



About Us



I’m Kaleb, and I’m building multiple home service businesses in the United States.



Right now, you’ll primarily support our growing fence company, but this role is designed to grow alongside the business.



As we launch additional companies, you’ll become a key part of helping operate all of them.



This is not a dead-end VA job.



I’m looking for someone who wants to build something long-term.



?



What You’ll Do



You’ll become one of the first members of our operations team.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Answering inbound phone calls from customers (excellent English is required)

* Responding quickly to new customer inquiries

* Creating and sending fence quotes (training provided)

* Following up with leads

* Scheduling appointments

* Coordinating with subcontractors

* Keeping customer information organized

* Helping improve our systems and processes

* Solving problems before they become problems



Every day will be a little different.



If you enjoy variety and taking ownership, you’ll love this role.



?



What Success Looks Like



The people who succeed here are:



* Extremely responsive

* Excellent communicators

* Comfortable talking with American customers

* Organized

* Detail-oriented

* Fast learners

* Independent thinkers

* Hungry to improve

* Able to solve problems without constant supervision



I don’t want someone who simply completes today’s task list.



I want someone who makes my life easier because they take ownership.



?



Compensation



This role starts as performance-based pay because we’re a startup. I believe the people who create the most value should earn the most.



Customer Quotes



* ???? $3 for every completed, accurate quote

* ???? +$20 when your quote results in a booked on-site consultation

* ???? +$30 when that customer becomes a paying job



A quote that goes all the way from inquiry to sold project earns you $53.



Inbound Phone Support



* ???? $10 for every qualified inbound call you handle

* ???? +$75 when one of your phone leads becomes a paying customer



The more responsibilities you take on, the more opportunities you’ll have to earn.



This role starts with answering inbound calls, responding to leads, sending quotes, coordinating with subcontractors, and helping keep our operations running smoothly.



As we grow, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of additional parts of the business. My goal is to promote from within, and the right person will transition into a stable monthly salary plus performance bonuses as they become an essential part of our operations.



?



What I’m Really Looking For



I’m not looking for someone to “help me.”



I’m looking for someone who eventually helps run the business.



I want someone I can trust.



Someone who follows through.



Someone who notices things that others miss.



Someone who makes customers feel taken care of.



Someone who takes pride in doing exceptional work.



If you become that person, I’ll continue investing in you as the business grows.



?



To Apply



Start your application with the word MONSTER so I know you actually read the posting.



Then answer these questions:



1. Tell me about yourself.

2. Why do you think you’d be a better fit than other applicants?

3. Tell me about a time you took ownership of a problem without being asked.

4. Have you answered inbound customer phone calls before? If so, tell me about that experience.

5. How would you rate your spoken English from 1–10?

6. How quickly do you normally respond to
s or messages during working hours?

7. Are you comfortable working U.S. Eastern business hours?

8. What’s something you’ve done at a previous job that wasn’t your responsibility, but you did it anyway because it needed to be done?



I’m looking for someone who wants to build something—not someone who’s just looking for their next gig. If you’re the kind of person who consistently exceeds expectations and takes ownership, I’d love to hear from you.

description:
Service Robot Co. is a commercial robotics company. We deploy and service robots (cleaning, delivery, security, and more) for businesses across the United States. title: Media Buyer
description:
We're looking for a proactive Media Buyer to join our growing marketing agency. Experience running Meta ads is a bonus, but it is not required



We're much more interested in finding someone who is resourceful, analytical, and obsessed with learning. We have a proven advertising strategy that we'll teach you. Your job is to learn it quickly, execute it consistently, and continuously improve campaigns based on performance.



If you're the type of person who enjoys figuring things out, solving problems, and taking ownership without needing constant direction, you'll fit in well here.



What You'll Be Doing



* Build and manage Meta advertising campaigns for multiple clients.

* Monitor campaign performance and make data-driven optimizations.

* Learn and implement our proprietary advertising strategy.

* Analyze key metrics and identify opportunities to improve results.

* Test new creatives, audiences, and campaign structures.

* Document findings and share insights with the team.

* Communicate campaign updates and performance when needed.

* Stay up to date on Meta advertising changes and best practices.



What We're Looking For



We care much more about your mindset than your experience.



You should be someone who:



* Is extremely proactive and takes initiative.

* Learns quickly without needing every step explained.

* Enjoys solving problems independently.

* Pays close attention to detail.

* Thinks critically instead of simply following instructions.

* Is comfortable working with numbers and performance metrics.

* Takes ownership of mistakes and works to improve.

* Is organized and able to manage multiple client accounts.

* Communicates clearly and professionally.

* Wants to continuously learn and become one of the best at your craft.



Experience: Not required.



We'll teach you our systems and strategy.



What matters most is your willingness to learn, your ability to think independently, and your work ethic.



Bonus Skills



These are nice to have but not required:



* Experience with Meta Ads Manager

* Marketing or advertising experience

* Copywriting

* Basic graphic design or creative analysis

* Familiarity with Google Sheets or Excel

* Experience using project management tools like ClickUp, Notion, or Asana



What Success Looks Like



Within your first few months, you'll be able to:



* Confidently manage multiple client ad accounts.

* Make proactive optimizations without waiting to be told.

* Understand campaign data and explain why performance changed.

* Identify problems before clients notice them.

* Consistently improve campaign performance by testing new ideas.



Application Instructions



To be considered for this position, **you must complete the following steps:**



1. Record a **1–3 minute video** introducing yourself and answering the following:



   * Tell us about your previous work experience (marketing experience is a plus but not required).

   * What is your current availability? (Hours per week and time zone.)

   * What are your career goals, and why are you interested in this position?

 your video (or a shareable link if the file is too large) to **both** of the following
 addresses:

   * 



Applications that do not include the required video or are not sent to both
 addresses will not be considered.





We're looking for someone who naturally takes ownership, enjoys learning independently, and is excited to become an expert in performance marketing.

title: Personal Assistant & Finance Admin — Full-Time Remote Agency Role
description:
# Personal Assistant & Finance Admin — Full-Time Remote Agency Role



We are looking for a highly organised, reliable, and proactive **Personal Assistant / Finance Administrator** to join our growing agency.



This is a **full-time remote agency role**. You may support our internal team and, depending on business needs, may also be assigned to support one of our clients.



We work with fast-moving businesses, including companies in the UK property sector, so we need someone who can stay organised, communicate professionally, handle sensitive information, and make sure important tasks actually get completed.



# REQUIRED SCREENING TASK — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



To be considered, you must submit a **1–2 minute Loom video** answering the questions below.



Please keep your answers clear and direct.



In your Loom video, explain:



1. Tell us briefly about your previous experience in PA, admin, finance, bookkeeping, or similar work.



2. What systems or platforms have you used before? For example: Excel, Google Sheets, accounting software, CRMs, property software,
 management systems, or payment platforms.



3. Imagine your manager has several urgent tasks, an overdue payment to chase, and an important meeting coming up. How would you d
 what to do first?



4. Tell us about a time you noticed a mistake, missing information, or a problem before someone else pointed it out. What did you do?



5. How would you handle confidential personal or business information?



6. Why do you think you would be a strong fit for a fast-moving PA and finance admin role?



**Applications without a Loom video may not be considered.**



## What We Are Looking For



You should be:



* Highly organised and dependable

* Comfortable working with numbers and spreadsheets

* Strong in spoken and written English

* Proactive rather than dependent on constant instructions

* Confident following up with people

* Careful with confidential information

* Able to prioritise urgent tasks

* Comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities

* Able to solve straightforward problems independently

* Detail-oriented without becoming unnecessarily slow



## Role Responsibilities



You may be responsible for:



* Managing and organising
s, messages, reminders, and follow-ups

* Supporting business and personal administrative tasks

* Maintaining spreadsheets and financial records

* Tracking invoices, payments, expenses, and outstanding balances

* Following up on unpaid invoices or missing information

* Organising documents, receipts, and transaction records

* Preparing simple finance summaries and reports

* Scheduling meetings and managing priorities

* Communicating professionally with tea
mbers, clients, contractors, and suppliers

* Handling sensitive personal and business information confidentially

* Spotting missing information, errors, or overdue tasks before they become bigger problems

* Supporting different client accounts as part of an agency environment



Experience with tools such as **Google Sheets, Excel, Gmail, accounting platforms, CRMs, property software, or payment platforms** is beneficial.



## Role Details



* Full-time remote position

* Agency role

* Long-term opportunity

* Starting pay: **$500 USD per month**

* Opportunity for increased responsibility and progression based on performance

* You may work with our internal team and/or be assigned to support client businesses



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your CV

2. A short written introduction

3. Your **1–2 minute Loom video** answering the screening questions above



We are looking for someone who is reliable, proactive, organised, and genuinely capable of taking responsibility in a fast-moving environment.

title: Sales & Marketing Specialist for Credit Repair (Commission + Long-Term Opportunity)
description:
I’m looking for an experienced Sales & Marketing Specialist to help me launch and grow my credit repair business. This isn’t just a VA position—I’m looking for someone who can help build a real business from the ground up.



Your #1 Responsibility: Generate & Close New Clients



Your primary role will be to consistently generate qualified leads and close new credit repair clients.



Daily Goal:



Close at least 1 new client per day



Compensation:



My credit repair service is $500 per client

You will earn 20% commission ($100) for every client you successfully close.

As the business grows, there will be opportunities for increased pay, bonuses, and additional responsibilities.



Why I’m Hiring



I’
 tried running
 ads on my own, but I haven’t been able to consistently generate paying clients—even when offering my service for as little as $200. I know the demand is there, but I need someone with proven sales and marketing experience who can come in, generate leads, close sales, and help create a predictable system for bringing in new business.



If you’ve successfully grown a service-based business before, I’d love to hear from you.



Additional Responsibilities (Preferred)



If you have experience with any of the following, that’s a huge plus:



1. Build a Simple Client Funnel



Create an affordable and easy-to-use system where clients can:



Learn about our services

View testimonials or results

Complete an intake form

Upload documents securely

Submit payments online



I’m not looking for anything overly complicated—just something professional, effective, and inexpensive to maintain while the business is growing.



2. Credit Repair Experience (Optional)



If you have experience completing credit repair work, that’s a major advantage. If not, that’s completely okay—I can hire another specialist to handle the fulfillment side.



The Ideal Candidate



Proven experience generating leads and closing sales

Strong marketing knowledge 
, Instagram, organic outreach, or other lead-generation methods)

Excellent communication skills

Self-motivated and dependable

Able to work independently and produce results

Credit repair experience is a bonus, not a requirement



I’m looking for someone who wants to build something long-term. If you can consistently bring in new clients and help grow the business, there will be plenty of opportunities to increase your income as we expand.



To Apply, Please Answer the Following:



Tell me about your experience in sales and lead generation.

Have you worked with a credit repair company before?

What strategies would you use to generate credit repair clients?

What results have you achieved in previous roles?

Why do you think you’re the right person for this position?



I’m looking for someone who can start immediately and make an impact. If you’re confident in your ability to generate business and close sales, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Social Media Manager to join a remote team supporting a US-based client. In this role, you will own the day-to-day management of the client's social media presence, develop content that connects with their audience, and help grow their brand across key platforms. You will work closely with the client's team, communicate regularly in English, and bring both strategic thinking and hands-on execution to the role.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Manage and maintain the client's social media accounts across platforms including Instagram,
, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X.

• Develop, write, and schedule engaging content including captions, graphics briefs, short-form video scripts, and stories.

• Build and maintain a content calendar aligned to the client's campaigns, promotions, and business goals.

• Monitor comments, messages, and mentions and respond in a timely and on-brand voice.

• Track and report on key performance metrics including reach, engagement, follower growth, and conversions.

• Research trends, competitor activity, and audience insights to inform content strategy.

• Coordinate with the client on campaign approvals, brand guidelines, and upcoming priorities.

• Support paid social campaigns by assisting with creative assets, copy, and performance tracking as needed.



REQUIREMENTS

• 3 to 5 years of experience managing social media accounts professionally, either in-house or as a freelancer.

• Direct experience supporting US-based clients or US-based audiences is required.

• Strong written English communication skills with the ability to write in a clear, engaging, and on-brand voice.

• Solid understanding of platform best practices across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X.

• Ability to interpret analytics and translate data into actionable recommendations.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a content calendar and meet deadlines independently.

• Strong experience writing compelling calls to action that drive engagement, clicks, leads, or conversions across social platforms.

• Comfortable with direct client communication via video calls,
, and messaging tools.

• A portfolio or work samples is a plus. If you have one, please share it with your application. If not, we will request samples during the interview.



TOOLS AND PLATFORMS

• Content scheduling: Later, Buffer, Hootsuite, or similar

• Design: Canva, Adobe Express, or equivalent

• Analytics: Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Analytics, Google Analytics

• Project management: Asana, Trello, 
, or similar

• Communication: Slack, Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams

• Video: CapCut or similar short-form video editing tools (a plus)



WHAT WE OFFER

• A long-term, stable remote role supporting a vetted US-based client.

• Competitive compensation paid twice a month via Wise.

• No long-term contracts on the client side, which means the relationships we place you in are built on fit, not obligation.



To be considered, please send your resume, a brief introduction, and links to social media accounts or a portfolio you have managed. We review every application and will reach out directly if your background is a strong fit.

title: Virtual Assistant NEEDED (Experienced!)
description:
I am looking for an experienced Virtual Assistant who is SMART, FAST and works hard. I run an online coaching business based in the Netherlands, and I love working with dedicated, detail-oriented VAs long-term.



About my business: I coach women who have had cancer, helping them rebuild energy, confidence and a full life after treatment. My program combines hypnotherapy, coaching and lifestyle guidance, delivered through an online course platform and group program.



I am looking to add someone HARD WORKING, HONEST and DEDICATED to the team as soon as possible!



Important: all our content, our course platform, and our client communication is in DUTCH. You do NOT need to speak Dutch, but you DO need to be comfortable working with Dutch text and interfaces, and know how to use tools like ChatGPT or Claude to understand or translate content when needed. This is a MUST.



Tasks will include (but are not limited to):

• Uploading and organizing videos in our (Dutch-language) course platform (Huddle)

• Basic video editing (trimming intros/outros)

•
 marketing support in ActiveCampaign / MailBlue

• General VA tasks: data entry, formatting, recurring admin work



Experience with ActiveCampaign or MailBlue is a big plus.



Must be technologically SAVVY, a fast learner, and comfortable navigating software in a language you don't speak. We work with clear deadlines and clear instructions, but I need someone who pays attention to detail and follows directions precisely.

If this sounds like you, reply to this job post with your Viber number AND tell me: if you were an animal, what animal would you be and why?



We're starting with approximately 2 hours per week, with the potential to grow based on how well things go.

title: Social Media & Content VA
description:
About DCB Digital

We're a growing Queensland-based digital marketing agency and we're building something worth being part of. We work with professional services and trades businesses across Australia, delivering web design, SEO, paid ads, and social media for clients who are serious about results.

We move fast, we think in outcomes not tasks, and we're putting AI at the centre of everything we do. The people who join us now are getting in at the right time.



About the role

We don't hire to fill seats. We hire A players who want to grow, contribute, and be part of building something.

We're looking for a Social Media and Content VA who creates content that actually stops the scroll. Someone with at least 3 years of experience across multiple platforms, a sharp eye for what works, and the ability to use AI tools to make a real difference to content output, not just someone who knows how to write a prompt.

This role starts at 25 hours per week. For the right person it becomes full time. We're not looking for someone who wants to stay comfortable. We want someone who thinks outside the box, pushes themselves, and is always looking to learn and do better. If that's you, this is worth your time.

You'll be managing content across 9 accounts including 7 client accounts, DCB Digital's own brand, and the Directors' personal social media accounts across LinkedIn, Instagram,
, and TikTok. You'll post 3 times per week across all accounts with content adapted and optimised for each platform rather than copy and pasted.



How we work

We move fast. We don't spin wheels, we don't over-discuss, and we don't waste time on things that don't move the needle. When something needs doing it gets done, and it gets done properly.

Every piece of content has a reason behind it. We don't post for the sake of posting. We post to build audiences, drive engagement, and get results for our clients. We expect you to understand the why behind every piece of content you create, not just execute a brief.

We want someone who comes with ideas, stays across trends, and brings something to the table every single week without being asked.



What you'll be doing

Content creation



Creating engaging content across Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube for 9 accounts

Posting 3 times per week across all accounts with content adapted and optimised for each platform

Editing short-form video for Reels, TikTok, and Stories using CapCut, InShot, and AI-assisted tools

Designing graphics and branded social assets in Canva across multiple client brands

Writing captions that are on-brand, engaging, and suited to each platform and audience

Using AI tools including Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini to genuinely improve content quality, speed, and output

Staying across platform trends and applying them quickly and creatively

Building and growing DCB Digital's own brand presence across all platforms

Managing and growing the Directors' personal social media accounts



Social media management



Managing content calendars across all 9 accounts

Scheduling and publishing content via Later, Buffer, or Meta Business Suite

Monitoring account performance and adjusting content strategy based on what the data shows

Pulling engagement and performance reports using analytics tools and flagging what's working and what's not

Tracking outcomes and reporting results to the Directors in a clear and useful format

Growing client accounts organically through smart content strategy and engagement tactics

Active community management including responding to comments and DMs across all accounts



Strategy and ideation



Bringing fresh content ideas to the table weekly without being prompted

Identifying trends early and knowing how to make them work for each client brand

Reviewing performance data and making recommendations to improve results

Keeping each client brand looking and sounding distinct across all platforms

Thinking outside the box and pushing creative boundaries for every client

Recommending and setting up the right analytics tools to track outcomes properly





Tools you'll need to know



Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube (creation and management)

CapCut, InShot, and AI video editing tools

Canva and basic graphic design

Later, Buffer, or Meta Business Suite

Zoho (primary platform)

GoHighLevel (transitioning away, familiarity a bonus)

Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini, used properly, not just for prompting

Google Workspace including Google Drive

Social media analytics tools

Slack





What we need from you



Minimum 3 years experience in social media content creation and management (non-negotiable)

Proven experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously across all major platforms including Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube

Experience managing and growing personal brand accounts for Directors or executives

Strong video editing skills using CapCut and InShot for short-form content

Someone who actually knows how to use AI to make a real difference to content output. Not someone who knows how to write a prompt in ChatGPT. Someone who understands how to use AI tools to produce better content, faster, at a higher standard, and is always looking for new ways to push what's possible

Comfortable working within and across different client brand guidelines and keeping each brand sounding and looking like itself

Strong written English, your captions and copy need to be sharp and error free

Someone who understands what makes content perform, not just what makes it look good

Highly creative with a strong eye for design, trends, and audience behaviour

Experience with social media analytics tools and the ability to track, report, and act on performance data

Highly organised and able to manage multiple client content calendars simultaneously

Comfortable working in Zoho and picking up new platforms quickly

Someone who thinks outside the box and brings fresh ideas without being prompted

A genuine hunger to learn, grow, and push beyond what's expected

Someone who brings ideas and energy to the work every week without being chased

Available for 25 hours per week with the drive to grow into full time





Why work for us

DCB Digital is not your average agency. We're a team of people who genuinely want to be the best at what we do and care deeply about the results we get for our clients. We don't treat our clients as accounts, we treat them as partners. That means every person on our team is expected to show up with that same mindset, outcomes over activity, quality over volume, and real results over ticking boxes.

We work hard and we play hard. When you do great work here it gets noticed. We recognise the people who go above and beyond with genuine thanks, time off, and bonuses for those who earn it. We're not a team that lets good work go unseen.

We invest in our people. We teach what we know, we share what we learn, and we're open to investing in training for the right person. If you want to grow, we'll back you to do it.

Three times a week we come together as a team for huddles that keep everyone connected, aligned, and moving in the same direction. Beyond that you have the autonomy to do your best work without someone looking over your shoulder.

Working at DCB Digital feels like being part of a team that genuinely wants to achieve something, where the standard is high, the culture is real, and the reward follows the effort.



What we offer



Part-time role starting at 25 hours per week with full-time potential for the right person

Performance bonuses based on outcomes and account growth

Recognition through genuine thanks, time off, and financial reward when you go above and beyond

Team huddles three times a week to keep you connected and in the loop

Training and upskilling, we teach what we know and invest in the right people

Full autonomy to do your best work without being micromanaged

Direct access to the Directors

A culture that works hard, plays hard, and rewards the effort

Long-term stable remote role with a growing agency that's going somewhere





Why this role is worth your time

You'll be across real client accounts from day one with the creative freedom to do good work. This isn't a role where you follow a rigid brief and produce average content. We want someone who takes ownership of the content side and makes it better every month.

This role starts part time but it won't stay that way for the right person. If you perform, bring ideas, and show us you want more, full time is on the table. We're not interested in someone who is happy to coast at 25 hours. We want someone who sees this as the start of something bigger and has the hunger to match.

For the right person this is a long-term role with genuine upside. Perform well and there's more hours, more responsibility, and more money on the table.



You'll thrive here if you



Get genuinely excited when a trend drops and already know how to make it work for a brand

Can create content for multiple brands and keep each one sounding and looking like itself

Use AI tools to make a real difference, not just to save a few minutes

Think outside the box and bring ideas nobody asked for

Push yourself to learn new things before you're told to

See 25 hours as a starting point, not a ceiling

Take pride in content that actually performs, not just content that looks good

Are genuinely hungry to grow, not just comfortable

Want to grow into something bigger, not just fill your hours and disappear





This role is not for you if you



Have less than 3 years of hands-on social media and content creation experience

Think posting consistently is the same as a strategy

Think knowing how to write a ChatGPT prompt makes you good at AI

Are looking for an easy part-time role with no pressure to grow

Need a detailed brief before you can create anything

Are happy producing average content and calling it done

Are happy doing things the way they have always been done

Don't have the hunger to push yourself beyond what's expected

Only know one or two platforms well





To apply

Record a Loom video (5 minutes maximum) and include the link in your application. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

Start your application with the keyword Fast Lane so we know you have read this in full. Applications without it will not be considered.

Your Loom must cover:



Introduce yourself and tell us about your social media and content creation experience

Show us examples of content you have created across at least two different platforms

Tell us how you use AI tools to make a real difference to your content workflow, show us something specific, not just a prompt you typed into ChatGPT

Walk us through how you would approach content for a brand you have never worked with before

Tell us why this role is the right next step for you



We're looking for someone with a genuine creative eye, strong platform knowledge, and the kind of energy that comes through on screen. Someone who leads their Loom with generic claims and no examples will not progress.

Applications without a Loom video and the keyword Fast Lane will not be considered.

title: Amazon Marketplace Support Specialist
description:
Amazon Marketplace Support Specialist

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Amazon Marketplace Support Specialist to manage and optimize our Amazon selling operations. This role is critical in maintaining accurate product listings, resolving marketplace issues, and ensuring seamless integration between our Shopify platform and Amazon marketplace presence.



Key Responsibilities:

Amazon Listing Management



Update Existing Amazon Listings: Maintain and optimize current product listings including titles, descriptions, images, pricing, inventory levels, and product specifications to improve visibility and conversion rates

Load New Amazon Listings: Create and publish new product listings on Amazon marketplace, ensuring compliance with Amazon's listing policies and category-specific requirements

Issue Resolution & Support



Dialog with Amazon Support: Communicate directly with Amazon Seller Support to resolve listing issues, account problems, policy violations, and marketplace disputes in a timely and professional manner

Platform Integration Management: Collaborate with Shopify marketplace manager to synchronize product data, inventory levels, and listing updates between Shopify and Amazon platforms

Additional Responsibilities



Monitor listing performance metrics and suggest optimization strategies

Ensure compliance with Amazon marketplace policies and guidelines

Track and report on listing status, sales performance, and marketplace issues

Maintain accurate records of all marketplace communications and resolutions

Stay updated on Amazon policy changes and marketplace best practices



Required Qualifications



2+ years of experience managing Amazon Seller Central or similar e-commerce marketplace platforms

Strong understanding of Amazon listing optimization and SEO principles

Experience with Shopify platform and marketplace integrations

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data management

Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time management skills



Preferred Qualifications

Amazon marketplace certifications or training

Experience with inventory management systems

Knowledge of Amazon advertising (PPC) campaigns

Familiarity with product photography and listing optimization tools

Experience in e-commerce customer service or marketplace support



Skills & Competencies

Problem-solving and analytical thinking

Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

Customer service orientation

Technical aptitude for learning new software platforms

Understanding of e-commerce metrics and KPIs



Work Environment

This position may be performed remotely or in-office, with regular computer-based work and frequent communication with internal teams and external marketplace support representatives.

title: Remote Sales Representative / Client Coordinator (Fluent in English) - (US Hours) (MALE only)
description:
We are hiring 3 Client Advisors / Crisis Response Coordinators to join our remote team. We are currently prioritizing candidates for Shift B. All shift schedules are based on Manila Time / Philippine Time (PHT).



As part of your application, please send a 60-second English voice recording introducing yourself, explaining why you are a strong fit for this role, and briefly summarizing your phone-based sales, client support, or customer service experience.



* Important Requirement: This is a full-time, dedicated role. We are looking for candidates who can fully commit to this position during the assigned shift.



This role is not suitable as a second job, side job, or additional freelance role. Because response time, reliability, and emotional availability are critical in this position, candidates must not be working another job that conflicts with their schedule, focus, or performance.



* About the Role: This role includes a sales component, but it is not an aggressive sales role. You will not be pushing a product to random leads.



Your job is to respond quickly to inbound inquiries, calm the client when needed, understand the urgency of the case, explain how the service works, recommend the right service package, and guide the client through agreement, payment, onboarding, and handoff to our operations team.



We are looking for candidates with a mature, steady, and confident phone presence. The right person should sound calm under pressure, communicate clearly with US-based clients, and handle sensitive conversations professionally.



* What You’ll Do:

- Respond to inbound leads through phone, SMS, WhatsApp,
, and messaging platforms within minutes.

- Conduct first consultations by listening to the client’s situation, assessing urgency, and recommending the most suitable service package.

- Explain the services, pricing, onboarding steps, contracts, and expectations clearly.

- Guide clients through the agreement, payment, and onboarding process.

- Coordinate with the operations team after the client signs up to ensure a smooth case handoff.

- Follow up with clients at key milestones, including after 24 hours, weekly updates, and service completion.

- Maintain accurate records in our dashboard, including lead status, call notes, messages, contracts, and follow-up tasks.

- Collect client feedback and reviews after successful service completion.

- Work reliably during your assigned shift to ensure fast response coverage.



* What We’re Looking For:

- At least 2 years of phone-based sales, customer service, client consultation, call center, or account support experience.

- Clear spoken English and the ability to communicate confidently with US-based clients.

- Calm, mature, and professional phone manner.

- Strong empathy and emotional control when speaking with distressed clients.

- Ability to guide a conversation without sounding pushy or aggressive.

- Experience handling objections, pricing conversations, and follow-ups.

- Strong reliability. Late starts, missed shifts, and no-shows directly affect client response times.

- Ability to fully commit to this role as your primary work commitment.

- Fast and stable internet connection.

- Quiet workspace suitable for professional calls.

- Own computer, headset, and microphone.

- Comfortable using CRM, dashboard, messaging, and calling tools.



* Nice to Have:

- Experience in legal services, insurance, cybersecurity, financial services, healthcare support, emergency support, trust and safety, or crisis-related customer service.

- Previous experience working with US-based clients.

- Inbound sales, client advisory, retention, or customer success background.

- Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Notion, GoHighLevel, Slack, WhatsApp Business, Aircall, RingCentral, Zendesk, or similar platforms.

- Experience in sensitive client conversations where confidentiality, trust, and clear communication are important.



* Priority Shift Schedule:

- We are currently prioritizing candidates for Shift B (4:00 AM – 12:00 PM Manila Time / PHT). Candidates must be consistently available during the full assigned shift.



* Compensation & Growth:

- Base salary: $800/month

- Commission: 3%–10% on closed deals, depending on monthly performance and collected revenue.

- Additional performance incentives may include client review bonuses and other performance-based rewards.

- Top performers may be promoted to Senior Client Advisor / Team Lead, with a base salary increase and additional training responsibilities.



* Employee Benefits:

- Monthly base salary + tiered commission.

- $10 bonus per verified customer review.

- $300 retention bonus every 3 months of tenure.

- 13th month pay: 1× base salary, paid by December 20, soft-conditional on hitting average commission performance.

- 10 days paid annual leave per year.

- 3 days paid sick leave per year, no doctor’s note required.

- 2× pay if you work on Philippine regular public holidays.

- Full Sunday off, guaranteed weekly rest day.



* Hiring Process:

- Application review.

- Resume/CV and voice recording review.

- Written screening assessment.

- Live interview with scenario-based questions.

- Reference/profile check.

- Offer, NDA, agreement, and onboarding.



* How to Apply:

- Please submit your resume/CV and a 60-second English voice recording.



* In your recording, please include:

- A brief introduction of yourself.

- Why you believe you are a strong fit for this role.

- A short summary of your phone-based sales, customer service, call center, client consultation, or account support experience.

- Confirmation that you can fully commit to this role during Shift B and that this will not be treated as a second job.

title: Lead Engine Specialist
description:
Do you light up when you get someone on the phone?



If you're the person who would rather make 50 calls than send 50
s — who genuinely enjoys striking up a conversation with a stranger and finding out what's going on in their world — keep reading. This role was built for you.



Sure Home Buyers helps homeowners across Southwest Missouri sell their property quickly and without the hassle of a traditional listing. Behind every deal is one thing: a real conversation with a homeowner who needed a solution. You are the person who starts those conversations and keeps them going.



This is the cornerstone seat in our business. You generate the leads, build the relationships, nurture the maybes, and hand truly motivated sellers to our acquisitions team ready to talk. When you do this well, the whole business moves.



Who we are



We're a startup with one clear goal: to become the go-to home buyer in Southwest Missouri — not the biggest, the most trusted.



The people we help are usually in a tough spot. Facing foreclosure. Holding a property they never wanted or inherited. Tangled in a complex title problem they don't know how to solve. They don't need a sales pitch — they need a way out. Our job is to listen first, build a creative solution that actually fits their situation, and hand them back something they've been missing: peace of mind.



That shapes who we hire. We serve, we don't pressure. The right person for this seat genuinely cares about the person on the other end of the line — and then knows how to move the conversation forward. Hold both, and you'll fit right in. And because we're early, you're getting in on the ground floor of something we're building to last.



What you'll own



Reach out — warm and cold. Spend the majority of your day on the phone and texting. Cold outreach to fresh lists, warm follow-up with people who've already raised a hand, and fast response to inbound leads.

Follow the script, read the room. We give you proven scripts for each lead type. You'll know them cold and still sound like a human, not a robot.

Set the appointments. Your number-one outcome: book qualified appointments for our acquisitions team — multiple per week from genuinely motivated sellers.

Run a clean CRM. Pull and load lead lists, log every touch, take detailed notes, update statuses, and keep our pipeline organized and current. No lead falls through the cracks on your watch.

Enrich the data. Dig in and fill out every lead record — phone numbers, owner details, property info — so we know as much as possible about every person before we call.

Nurture the funnel. Stay on top of follow-up so warm leads don't go cold and every motivated seller keeps moving toward a conversation with acquisitions.

What a good week looks like



You've worked your lists hard, had real conversations with dozens of homeowners, your CRM is spotless, and you've set several solid appointments with sellers who actually want to talk. Acquisitions opens their calendar and the next steps are obvious. You go into the weekend knowing exactly what you produced — and so do we.



Who you are



You love talking to people. This is non-negotiable. The phone energizes you; it doesn't drain you.

You're relentlessly organized. Notes, follow-ups, and CRM hygiene are second nature.

You're goal-oriented. You like a target and you like hitting it. You measure your day in conversations and appointments.

You're coachable and self-directed. You'll follow our scripts and systems, and you'll run your day without someone standing over you.

Bonus, not required: experience in real estate, sales, appointment setting, telemarketing, customer service, or any phone-heavy role.

Compensation



This is a performance-based 1099 contract built to reward activity and results:



Paid per qualified contact you make

Paid per appointment you set

Bonus on every deal that closes — uncapped

The harder and smarter you work the phone, the more you earn. If you're driven and consistent, this rewards you for it.



The details



Schedule: Part-time, flexible hours within standard calling windows

Classification: 1099 independent contractor

Location: Fully remote. We're prioritizing candidates local to Southwest Missouri, but strong candidates anywhere will be considered.

The work: Phone and text the majority of the time. You'll need a reliable computer, a quiet space, and solid internet.

How to apply — read this carefully



Because this role is all about how you connect with people, your application starts with your voice.



Send two things to 



A 60-second-or-less video of yourself. Tell us who you are and why you'd be great at talking to homeowners all day. Don't overthink it — a phone selfie video is perfect. We want to see your energy.

Your resume.

That's it. Applications without a video won't be reviewed — the video is the first step. We're excited to meet you.

title: Figma Case Study Designer & Motion Designer (Full-Time)
description:
We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented Designer to join our team full-time. Your main responsibility will be to review our existing Figma project files, select the strongest projects, and transform them into polished, animated case studies for our company website.

title: HR Specialist/ (Full-Time, Remote – Philippines)
description:
Company Overview

DrayEasy Inc is a steadily developing international enterprise. We are seeking a versatile HR Specialist based in the Philippines to independently conduct full-cycle human resource operations. This role emphasizes employee relations management, requiring candidates to be adaptable and detail-oriented in a fast-paced working environment. Fluent in Chinese is a strong plus.



Job Summary

The HR Specialist will be in charge of end-to-end recruitment, personnel transfer & separation, performance management, one-on-one employee counseling, staff care, and training arrangements. The ideal candidate must be independent, empathetic, proficient in employee communication, and familiar with employee risk management. You need to be process-driven, meticulous, and capable of adapting to a fast-paced remote working environment. Candidates with Chinese language proficiency will be given priority consideration.



Key Responsibilities

1. Full-cycle Recruitment: Publish job openings, screen resumes, conduct interviews, coordinate hiring processes, and complete talent matching according to department staffing demands.

2. Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage employee onboarding, job transfer, status adjustment, resignation and termination procedures; organize and file employee documents to ensure complete and standardized personnel files.

3. Performance Management: Assist in optimizing performance appraisal systems, organize regular performance evaluations, sort assessment data, follow up on performance feedback, and complete data statistics.

4. Employee Relations: Maintain daily communication with employees, respond to HR-related inquiries, properly handle daily employee relation issues, and build a positive team atmosphere.

5. Training & Employee Care: Organize employee onboarding training and deliver HR policy training; arrange one-on-one employee interviews and emotional counseling, track staff dynamics, and improve employee retention rate.



Qualifications & Requirements

1. Minimum 2 years of solid HR working experience, familiar with recruitment, employee lifecycle management, and performance management processes.

2. Proficient in employee relations management, skilled in one-on-one counseling, emotional guidance, staff care and training.

3. Strong data sorting ability, rigorous and detail-oriented in daily work.

4. Excellent interpersonal and coordination skills to communicate with all-level employees.

5. Self-motivated and responsible, capable of independently handling full-cycle HR tasks.

6. Proficient in Office software, able to make training materials and maintain employee relation records.

7. Must have backup internet such as prepaid WiFi/data for stable remote working.

8. Must have a power backup in case of power outages.

9. Shift arrangement: Day shift for the first month, then transfer to night shift permanently.

10. Ability to speak and understand Chinese is a bonus qualification.



Application Guidelines

If you are interested in this position, please submit the following materials:

1. Your updated resume (resume link is acceptable).

2. Interested candidates please submit your application and fill out the questionnaire via the link below:

ue2fl6z2dmj.sg.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrlgzDguRc5jayVxeQLRnvW8Vc



Notice: Please mention in your application message that you have completed the questionnaire. We will conduct preliminary screening by combining your questionnaire information and resume. Candidates who pass the initial screening will be contacted via email for an interview invitation. Wish you all the best.



Company Information

Company Website: www.drayeasy.com/



Company Benefits

We provide a stable working environment and clear career growth. Your professionalism and dedication will be highly valued. Candidates with Chinese skills enjoy better development opportunities and priority in recruitment. We are looking forward to your application!
